channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLhealthAndWellness, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Landmark court ruling linked to increased cross-state travel for abortion care
item.description: A large cohort study assessed population-level data before and after the Dobbs v Jackson decision, finding changes in abortion care patterns.

item.title: Dementia diagnosis underreporting common, linked to reduced care engagement
item.description: In a retrospective cohort study of older adults with probable dementia, underreporting was substantial and associated with lower care engagement.

item.title: Anti-IL-6 monoclonal antibody sustains biomarker reductions for six months
item.description: The investigational antibody pacibekitug produced sustained reductions in inflammation-related biomarkers over six months.

item.title: New philosophical framework reframes moral distress in health care
item.description: Nurses and physicians often know what care patients need, such as more bedside time or pain management changes.
